Generated seccomp filter allowing write, fsync, and getrandom syscalls only.

# Purpose
This header defines a generated seccomp BPF policy for the `fd_send_tile` component. It sets the allowed system calls to `write`, `fsync`, and `getrandom`, and it restricts `write` and `fsync` so they can use only file descriptor `2` or the `logfile_fd` value passed into [`populate_sock_filter_policy_fd_send_tile`](<#populate_sock_filter_policy_fd_send_tile>). The code also checks the runtime CPU architecture with `ARCH_NR` and kills the process if the architecture does not match the expected target. The file is used as a build-time security control in the codebase, and the generated filter is copied into a `sock_filter` array by [`populate_sock_filter_policy_fd_send_tile`](<#populate_sock_filter_policy_fd_send_tile>).
